ultra quàm Paucis Illis imputem, qui se Tur-

siæ & Regno debitæ, ut ejusmodi mihi buccellas
oblatas lente prius manducem quàm in Sto-
machum demittam: Sin conscientiæ meæ an-
gustia impediar, quo minus eâ quâ alii facili-
tate deglutiam hos in Deum & homines sacri-
legii & Injustitiæ Camelos, nulla causa est cur
expostulent haud æquè vastum mihi guttur ac
illis patere; Id Deo juvante fixum manet, nul-
la vel perturbatione, vel pervicaciâ, vel con-
tradicendi libidine, vel inani Negativæ Vocis
ostentatione ita transversum actum iri judi-
cium meum, ut sim voluntati meæ obsequu-
turus, quicquam unquam negando, quod Con-
scientia mea & Ratio negare vetuerit.

page.notes: Catchword "riam" is at the bottom right and completes "Glo-riam". Printed "huncOr-" has no space before "Or", as printed. The word "Multicipiti" is uncertain. The page number "§o" is an old-style numeral and is uncertain. A small mark stands at the left of the line "Neque vero", possibly a printer's mark or show-through, and is not transcribed. Greek running head is transcribed in Greek letters as printed.
